fields.label: CLIENT_NAME

fields.label: CONNECT_RETRIES
fields.helperText: Number of connection retry attempts when establishing initial connection

fields.label: RECONNECT_RETRIES
fields.helperText: Number of reconnect retries after connection loss. -1 indicates infinite retries

fields.label: CONNECT_RETRIES_PER_HOST
fields.helperText: Number of connection retries per Solace host

fields.label: RECONNECT_RETRY_WAIT_IN_MILLIS
fields.helperText: Wait time in milliseconds between reconnect attempts

fields.label: API_PROPERTIES
fields.helperText: Number of connection retries per Solace host

fields.label: START_TIME
fields.helperText: epoch time - used to filter files modified after this time

fields.label: ENABLED
fields.helperText: Set this value to 0 to disable and 1 to enable FTP/FTPs source location. Default 0, the file will be searched for on the local source machine and if set to 1, the files will be pulled from a remote location on the ftp server. Enabling this shifts the connector from local file system operations to remote FTP/FTPs interactions, allowing integration with external servers for file polling, listing, and transfer.

fields.label: SERVER_USERNAME
fields.helperText: FTP user username. The credentials for authenticating with the FTP server. Anonymous access may use 'anonymous' if supported by the server, but a valid username is typically required.

fields.label: SERVER_PASSWORD
fields.helperText: FTP user password. The password corresponding to the username for server authentication. For security, store this in a secure vault or environment variable rather than plaintext configuration.

fields.label: SERVER_IP
fields.helperText: FTP Server IP. Specify the hostname or IP address of the remote FTP/FTPs server to connect to. This is required when enabled is true; empty value defaults to local file system if not set.

fields.label: SERVER_PORT
fields.helperText: FTP server port number. The default port is 21 for plain FTP; use 990 for implicit FTPS. Ensure the port matches the server's configuration to establish successful connections.

fields.label: TRACE_ENABLED
fields.helperText: Enable detailed FTP command/response tracing. Logs all FTP protocol exchanges at TRACE level via SLF4J disable in production to reduce log volume.

fields.label: USE_FTPS
fields.helperText: Enables FTPS (TLS-secured FTP) for encrypted control and data channels. Requires proper SSL/TLS configuration.

fields.label: IMPLICIT_FTPS
fields.helperText: Use implicit FTPS mode (typically port 990). Entire session is encrypted from the start. Effective only when useFTPS=true.

fields.label: STRICT_HOST_KEY_CHECKING
fields.helperText: Verifies the server hostname against its certificate to prevent spoofing. Disable only for non-production or self-signed certificates.

fields.label: KEY_STORE_PATH
fields.helperText: Path to the keystore file containing the client certificate for mutual TLS authentication.

fields.label: KEY_STORE_PASSWORD
fields.helperText: Password to unlock the keystore file. Required if keyStorePath is provided.

fields.label: TRUST_STORE_PATH
fields.helperText: Path to the truststore containing trusted CA certificates to validate the FTPS server.

fields.label: TRUST_STORE_PASSWORD
fields.helperText: Password for the truststore file; required when trustStorePath is provided.

fields.label: ENABLED_TLS_PROTOCOLS
fields.helperText: Comma-separated list of enabled TLS protocols (e.g., TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3). Effective only when useFTPS=true.

fields.label: PASSIVE_MODE
fields.helperText: Enables passive mode for data connections. Recommended for clients behind NAT or firewalls.

fields.label: ACTIVE_MIN_PORT
fields.helperText: Minimum local port for active mode data connections (0 for system-assigned).

fields.label: ACTIVE_MAX_PORT
fields.helperText: Maximum local port for active mode data connections. Must be >= activeMinPort.

fields.label: LIST_HIDDEN_FILES
fields.helperText: Include hidden files in directory listings.

fields.label: USE_EPSV_WITH_IPV4
fields.helperText: Enable EPSV command in passive mode for IPv4 networks.

fields.label: REMOTE_VERIFICATION_ENABLED
fields.helperText: Verify remote hostname/IP in passive mode responses to detect misrouting.

fields.label: SERVER_SYSTEM_KEY
fields.helperText: Server system type used for parsing directory listings.

fields.label: DEFAULT_FILE_TRANSFER_TYPE
fields.helperText: Default file transfer mode. Use BINARY to avoid data corruption.

fields.label: SERVER_TIMEZONE
fields.helperText: Timezone of the FTP server used for parsing timestamps.

fields.label: CONNECT_TIMEOUT
fields.helperText: Connection timeout in milliseconds.

fields.label: KEEP_ALIVE_INTERVAL
fields.helperText: Control keep-alive interval in milliseconds.

fields.label: ADAPTER_ID
fields.helperText: unique ID for the connector

fields.label: FILE_TYPE
fields.helperText: type of file (1 -> static 2 -> Dynamic 3 -> Directory first level 4 -> Directory recursive)

fields.label: IGNORE_EMPTY_FILES
fields.helperText: true->Ignores replication for empty files, false->Replicates empty files too

fields.label: COPY_FILE_MODE_PERMISSIONS
fields.helperText: (0 -> do not copy 1 -> copy)

fields.label: CLEAR_STATE_ON_EOD
fields.helperText: (0 -> doesn't clear state in LVQ 1 -> clears state in LVQ)

fields.label: EOD_TIME_SEC
fields.helperText: -1 -> disabled 0 -> midnight time  (Hours to Seconds) - connector will check if configured time has passed number of seconds and exits.

fields.label: WILDCARD_TYPE
fields.helperText: 0 -> disabled 1 -> whitelist 2 -> blacklist

fields.label: DIR_REGEXPS_CONFIG
fields.helperText: Regex values seperated by |

fields.label: RESTART_TIME_SEC
fields.helperText: integer value representing number of seconds between each restart

fields.label: SMF_URL
fields.helperText: tcp,smf host and port :e.g:<PROTOCOL>://<HOST>:<PORT>/slug , seperated by comma

fields.label: ALLOW_SSL
fields.helperText: To enable broker ssl

fields.label: ALLOW_SEMP
fields.helperText: To create broker objects

fields.label: TOPIC
fields.helperText: destination file location path

fields.label: QUEUE
fields.helperText: Will create a queue with provided topic subscription

fields.label: MODE
fields.helperText: The connector’s leader election mode. (values: standalone, active_active, active_standby)

fields.label: MAX_ATTEMPTS
fields.helperText: The maximum number of attempts to perform a fail-over.

fields.label: BACK_OFF_INITIAL_INTERVAL
fields.helperText: The initial interval (milliseconds) to back-off when retrying a fail-over.

fields.label: BACK_OFF_MAX_INTERVAL
fields.helperText: The maximum interval (milliseconds) to back-off when retrying a fail-over.

fields.label: BACK_OFF_MULTIPLIER
fields.helperText: The multiplier to apply to the back-off interval between each retry of a fail-over.

fields.label: QUEUE
fields.helperText: The management queue name.
